author: Good Enough
description:
An ordinary umbrella once became one of the most infamous tools linked to Cold War espionage.

Designed to look completely harmless, this modified umbrella concealed a hidden mechanism capable of delivering a nearly undetectable attack in public without drawing attention. The device later became associated with one of the most well-known covert operations of the Cold War.

This Short explores the strange true story behind the so-called “umbrella weapon” and how spies turned everyday objects into secret tools.
